classes.label: eg-ar-titulo
classes.css: font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 6vw, 5rem); line-height: 1; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.04em; color: var(--eg-papel);

classes.label: eg-ar-filtro
classes.css: display: flex; flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; margin-top: 2.25rem;

classes.label: eg-ar-rejilla
classes.css: display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); grid-template-rows: auto; gap: 2.5rem 1.5rem; padding: 0; @media(--tablet) { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } @media(--mobile) { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2rem; }

classes.label: eg-pr-card
classes.css: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%;

classes.label: eg-pr-card-media
classes.css: position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; border-radius: 1.25rem; overflow: hidden; padding: 0; background-color: var(--eg-niebla);

classes.label: eg-pr-card-texto
classes.css: display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1.25rem 0.25rem 0;

classes.label: eg-pr-card-titulo
classes.css: font-size: 1.375rem; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--eg-tinta);

classes.label: eg-pr-card-desc
classes.css: font-family: var(--eg-sora); font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--eg-gris);
